source: Vinokurova N. Lexical Categories and Argument Structure: A Study with Reference to Sakha. Utrecht, 2005. (LOT Dissertation Series, no. 103)
topic: Absence of relationality with possessive predicates
notes: The behavior of the examples in (80) and (81) at the clausal level also supports the view of inalienability as licensed by the possessor in Spec,DP. When the possessor is extracted e.g. to Spec,LocP as in (85), only the reading in (80) remains: the ‘creator’-interpretation of (81), being contextually determined by the possessed noun, is no longer possible because the possessor has moved out.
